description: An object for key that is null after an unknown key gives the dynamic value
notes: The spec says each key becomes an attribute name, which null can't be, and that unknown values give the dynamic pseudo-type only when they are otherwise type-valid. ForExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) only reports a null key or one that can't convert to a string while every earlier key was known, so after an unknown key it skips the error and returns the dynamic value.
